title: manuscript-guard author block
description: One validated file that fills the title page, the declarations section and the submission form. Structured rather than prose because journals want more than name and affiliation, and because a missing ORCID or CRediT role should be a build failure rather than something noticed at 23:00 on the submission deadline.

equal_contribution_note.description: Sentence printed for the equal-contribution group, e.g. 'A.B. and C.D. contributed equally to this work.'

roles.description: The people who sign off what only they may close, with `manuscript-guard sign`: the statistician signs a G15 warning left standing. The corresponding author is the one `corresponding: true` marks.

ethics_lead.description: The person responsible for the ethics approval, with the approval's reference.

holder.description: An author, named as `approve --as` names one (ORCID iD, e-mail address, full name or family name), or someone who is not an author, by name.

approval.description: The reference of the ethics approval, for the ethics lead.

orcid.description: Bare identifier without the https://orcid.org/ prefix.

affiliations.description: Affiliation ids, in the order they should be printed.

equal_contribution.description: true or false, or a group label when a paper has more than one equal-contribution group (e.g. 'first', 'last').

credit.description: CRediT taxonomy roles. Required by a growing number of journals.

competing_interests.description: Free text, or the project's declared none-statement. Empty is not the same as 'none' and is treated as unfilled.
